description: A task card's accessible name does not include who is on it. The card button's computed name is "P2 Migrate invoice PDFs to S3 Unassigned Here now": the "Here now" group's aria-label replaces its children, so the marker names ("Juniper, agent, active, on this task") are never announced on the card.
expected: Card name ends with "Here now: Juniper, agent, active" (or the markers are described via aria-describedby).
actual: Screen reader hears "Here now" with no names.
suggested_fix: Drop aria-label from the marker group inside the card (use visible text or aria-describedby listing the names).

description: On active avatars the focus outline (2px rgb(118,223,186)) is the same accent colour as the active presence ring, so a focused active avatar looks almost the same as an unfocused one.
expected: Focus indicator distinct from the presence ring (offset white ring, as offline avatars get).
actual: Accent-on-accent; the difference is a slightly thicker ring.
suggested_fix: Use the neutral offset box-shadow ring for all avatars' :focus-visible.

description: Presence changes are not announced: the only live regions are the two "Saved locally · synced" status elements. A screen-reader user must revisit avatars to notice a change.
expected: Optional polite announcement for presence changes of people relevant to the open task, or none by design but documented.
suggested_fix: Announce focus arrivals/departures on the open task through a polite live region.
